scenario.summary: Retailers during peak shopping season face a diverse threat landscape including digital skimming via CVE-2024-34102, AI-accelerated autonomous intrusions, and cloud-based gift card fraud following employee phishing. These campaigns prioritize operational disruption through ransomware or direct financial gain via credential stuffing and payment record exfiltration.

meta.rationale: Focus on administrative accounts and retail employees with access to gift card management or e-commerce control panels.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has compromised a retail employee account via social engineering and is now using an autonomous AI agent to conduct high-velocity reconnaissance and fraudulent gift card issuance within a sub-10-hour window.

hunt.name: Autonomous AI Retail Intrusions and Cloud Fraud
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the internal and cloud control plane impact of AI-powered retail intrusions. We identify suspicious authentication leads—such as proxy-based logins or risk-flagged sessions—and use them as a gate to trigger deeper investigation into endpoint and cloud telemetry. The hunt specifically looks for the execution of autonomous penetration testing agents like Cairn and high-velocity cloud API operations used by groups like Storm-0539 for gift card fraud and data theft.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, is_proxy, risk_state, debug_behaviors, device_hostname, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (is_proxy = 'true' OR risk_state IN ('atRisk', 'confirmedCompromised') OR LOWER(debug_behaviors) LIKE '%negative%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find employee logins that exhibit markers of compromise, such as proxy usage or negative risk behaviors, as a lead for an identity-based intrusion.
config.expected_signal: A list of users and hosts associated with atypical or high-risk authentication. Silence suggests no such logins were logged by the provider.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, COUNT(*) as op_count, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{fraud_api_ops}}' || ',', ',' || api_operation || ',') > 0 OR api_category = 'GiftCardManagement') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name HAVING op_count > 10 AND (julianday(last_seen) - julianday(first_seen)) * 24 <= 10
config.description: Identify the compressed timeline of an autonomous intrusion by looking for actors performing dozens of sensitive operations in a sub-10-hour window.
config.expected_signal: A single user account performing high volumes of sensitive API operations in a very short timeframe. Silence proves no such high-velocity bursts occurred in the audit log.
